excluded_runs.20260923-122157-reanchor: Outside the operating envelope: took off at 51 % (42 % right after takeoff) and 76-77 C, below the runbook's 50 % pre-flight floor, and ended on the Tello's own 'error Auto land' at 10 % during the RETURN correction (docs/wp5-bigbang-2026-09-23.md in the integration worktree). Its first leg carries the 0.45 cm/cm outlier (54.7 cm open-loop error) and its battery reading collapses nonlinearly below 30 %.

xy_drift_per_cm.statistic: p90 of per-leg open-loop error / commanded path since the last tag fix, 7 legs of the 2 nominal flights, + 20 % margin
xy_drift_per_cm.justification: Task B2: the worst single leg (0.45 cm/cm, 2026-09-23 12:21 first leg) comes from a run excluded above; the old per-leg ratio also divided by the straight-line distance from the previous waypoint, not the path flown since the last fix the tracker resets on. The robust statistic over the nominal legs is 0.1312 cm/cm; with a 20 % margin 0.1575.

declared_notes.xy_drift_cm_s: Task B2 fix 1, operator judgment (not a measurement; the 0.1 it replaces was not one either): hover drift 0.05 cm/s. The history cannot measure it (the stop bursts last about 2 s, noise-dominated), and the robust per-leg statistic above already bounds every nominal leg's open-loop error, including the hover time inside that leg, without any hover term. The tracker charges this rate again over every command's worst-case bound (SET_SPEED 21 s, vertical telemetry 7 s, ...). At 0.1 cm/s no lateral CanningSt observation is admissible at the history drift; at 0.05 cm/s the left/right observations at x 226/274 are.
